title: Colleagues' grandparents were UFO report people on the Manhattan Project

tellings.quote:
there are some people I'm uh colleagues
with that like their grandparents were
actually you know the UFO report people
on the Manhattan Project

plain: During the 1940s, some people working on the Manhattan Project, the US wartime program that built the atomic bomb, are said to have been the ones handling UFO reports. A whistleblower named David Grusch tells this on the show, passing on what colleagues told him: their own grandparents were "the UFO report people on the Manhattan Project." If true, UFO secrecy would reach back to the start of the atomic age.
